author: A4 (D4)
schemaSource: src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts -> VietlishCorpusEntry { vietlish, natural, sourcePattern, category, frequency, context }
definition: Each entry is a NEW Vietnamese L1-interference candidate matching the live VIETLISH_CORPUS entry schema EXACTLY. These are staged for human review BEFORE any promotion into src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts. This file is imported by no engine module — review queue only. Every `vietlish` string is verified disjoint from the 354 live corpus entries by step11VietlishCorpusD4Wave.test.ts.
disjointFrom: live VIETLISH_CORPUS (src/lib/tutor/vietlishCorpus.ts); A6 !690 (selector test, no corpus rows); A10 corpus waves (different files).

entries.vietlish: how long you study English already
entries.natural: how long have you been studying English
entries.sourcePattern: ban hoc tieng Anh bao lau roi -> question word order plus already for duration
entries.context: How long you study English already? Your accent is good.

entries.vietlish: there are many furnitures in the room
entries.natural: there is a lot of furniture in the room
entries.sourcePattern: nhieu do dac -> furniture pluralized and treated as plural agreement
entries.context: There are many furnitures in the room, it feels crowded.

entries.vietlish: the childrens are playing
entries.natural: the children are playing
entries.sourcePattern: tre con -> irregular plural double-marked with -s
entries.context: The childrens are playing in the yard after school.

entries.vietlish: she was born in 1995 in March
entries.natural: she was born in March 1995
entries.sourcePattern: sinh nam 1995 thang ba -> year-before-month order from Vietnamese
entries.context: She was born in 1995 in March, the same month as me.

entries.vietlish: she hits makeup every morning
entries.natural: she puts on makeup every morning
entries.sourcePattern: danh phan -> danh maps to hit for applying makeup
entries.context: She hits makeup every morning before work.

entries.vietlish: she bears a baby last month
entries.natural: she had a baby last month
entries.sourcePattern: sinh em be -> bear for give birth, present for past
entries.context: She bears a baby last month, a healthy boy.

entries.vietlish: the alarm rings me at six
entries.natural: the alarm wakes me at six
entries.sourcePattern: bao thuc goi -> ring for wake, transitive transfer
entries.context: The alarm rings me at six every morning.

entries.vietlish: he catches the train every morning
entries.natural: he takes the train every morning
entries.sourcePattern: di tau -> catch over-generalized for routine take
entries.context: He catches the train every morning to the city.

entries.vietlish: you go to school by what
entries.natural: how do you get to school
entries.sourcePattern: di hoc bang gi -> manner question with by what
entries.context: You go to school by what, bus or motorbike?

entries.vietlish: why she is crying
entries.natural: why is she crying
entries.sourcePattern: tai sao co ay khoc -> no subject-auxiliary inversion
entries.context: Why she is crying? Did something happen?

entries.vietlish: you can speak Vietnamese can not
entries.natural: can you speak Vietnamese or not
entries.sourcePattern: co the noi tieng Viet duoc khong -> A-not-A question pattern
entries.context: You can speak Vietnamese can not? I need help.

entries.vietlish: a so beautiful girl
entries.natural: such a beautiful girl
entries.sourcePattern: mot co gai dep nhu vay -> so/such confusion in noun phrase
entries.context: She is a so beautiful girl, everyone looks at her.

entries.vietlish: I have a black new car
entries.natural: I have a new black car
entries.sourcePattern: xe mau den moi -> adjective order color before age
entries.context: I have a black new car, I bought it last week.

entries.vietlish: very thank you
entries.natural: thank you very much
entries.sourcePattern: cam on rat nhieu -> degree word fronted before thank
entries.context: Very thank you for your help today.

entries.vietlish: teacher, today I cannot go to class
entries.natural: Teacher, I can't come to class today
entries.sourcePattern: thua thay/co -> title used as address with fronted time word
entries.context: Teacher, today I cannot go to class because I am sick.

entries.vietlish: sorry I am late, the traffic
entries.natural: sorry I am late because of the traffic
entries.sourcePattern: xin loi toi tre, ket xe -> reason given as a bare noun, no connector
entries.context: Sorry I am late, the traffic this morning was terrible.

entries.vietlish: I think so that it will rain
entries.natural: I think it will rain
entries.sourcePattern: toi nghi rang -> rang/la doubled as so that
entries.context: I think so that it will rain, bring an umbrella.

entries.vietlish: by the way, you finished the report or not
entries.natural: by the way, did you finish the report
entries.sourcePattern: xong chua -> A-not-A tag instead of did-question
entries.context: By the way, you finished the report or not?

entries.vietlish: teacher please can repeat one more time
entries.natural: Teacher, could you repeat that one more time
entries.sourcePattern: thay oi lam on nhac lai -> modal placement and dropped object
entries.context: Teacher please can repeat one more time? I did not hear.

entries.vietlish: thanks God it is Friday
entries.natural: thank God it's Friday
entries.sourcePattern: on troi -> fixed phrase pluralized as thanks
entries.context: Thanks God it is Friday, I need a rest.

entries.vietlish: long time no see you
entries.natural: long time no see
entries.sourcePattern: lau qua khong gap -> object added to a fixed greeting
entries.context: Hi! Long time no see you, how are you?

entries.vietlish: the news make me surprising
entries.natural: the news made me surprised
entries.sourcePattern: ngac nhien -> -ing participle for the affected person
entries.context: The news make me surprising, I did not expect it.

entries.vietlish: she is very sympathetic and beautiful
entries.natural: she is very sweet and beautiful
entries.sourcePattern: de thuong -> sympathetic borrowed for likeable/cute
entries.context: She is very sympathetic and beautiful, everyone likes her.

entries.vietlish: my salary is low, only enough
entries.natural: my salary is low, barely enough
entries.sourcePattern: chi du -> enough used alone for barely enough
entries.context: My salary is low, only enough for rent and food.

entries.vietlish: she is pregnant five months
entries.natural: she is five months pregnant
entries.sourcePattern: co ay co thai nam thang -> duration placed after the adjective
entries.context: She is pregnant five months, the baby is due in spring.

entries.vietlish: the doctor injected me a medicine
entries.natural: the doctor gave me an injection
entries.sourcePattern: tiem thuoc cho toi -> verb inject with double object plus a medicine
entries.context: The doctor injected me a medicine for the pain.

entries.vietlish: my stomach is not comfortable
entries.natural: I have an upset stomach
entries.sourcePattern: bung kho chiu -> kho chiu calqued as not comfortable
entries.context: I cannot eat much, my stomach is not comfortable today.

entries.vietlish: this bag is more expensive than that bag a lot
entries.natural: this bag is a lot more expensive than that one
entries.sourcePattern: dat hon nhieu -> intensifier a lot placed at the end
entries.context: This bag is more expensive than that bag a lot.

entries.vietlish: this coffee is enough sweet
entries.natural: this coffee is sweet enough
entries.sourcePattern: du ngot -> enough placed before the adjective
entries.context: This coffee is enough sweet, I don't need more sugar.

entries.vietlish: the box is too heavy for me to carry it
entries.natural: the box is too heavy for me to carry
entries.sourcePattern: nang qua toi khong khieng noi -> resumptive object pronoun kept
entries.context: The box is too heavy for me to carry it alone.

entries.vietlish: my house, it is near the school
entries.natural: my house is near the school
entries.sourcePattern: nha toi, no gan truong -> topic NP plus resumptive pronoun
entries.context: My house, it is near the school, so I walk.

entries.vietlish: the food here, I think it is delicious
entries.natural: I think the food here is delicious
entries.sourcePattern: do an o day, toi nghi -> topic fronting with resumptive it
entries.context: The food here, I think it is delicious and cheap.

entries.vietlish: my mother she works in a hospital
entries.natural: my mother works in a hospital
entries.sourcePattern: me toi ba ay lam -> subject doubled with a pronoun
entries.context: My mother she works in a hospital as a nurse.

entries.vietlish: I like coffee but my sister she likes tea
entries.natural: I like coffee but my sister likes tea
entries.sourcePattern: chi toi co ay thich -> resumptive subject pronoun after NP
entries.context: I like coffee but my sister she likes tea more.

entries.vietlish: my computer is hang
entries.natural: my computer froze
entries.sourcePattern: treo may -> hang as a stative adjective for froze
entries.context: My computer is hang, I cannot open any program.

entries.vietlish: I forgot my password, how to reset
entries.natural: I forgot my password, how do I reset it
entries.sourcePattern: lam sao de dat lai -> infinitive how-to instead of a full question
entries.context: I forgot my password, how to reset on this app?

entries.vietlish: the printer is run out of ink
entries.natural: the printer has run out of ink
entries.sourcePattern: het muc -> be inserted before run out, no present perfect
entries.context: The printer is run out of ink, I need a new one.

entries.vietlish: do you have this shirt in size bigger
entries.natural: do you have this shirt in a bigger size
entries.sourcePattern: size lon hon -> adjective placed after the noun
entries.context: Do you have this shirt in size bigger? This one is tight.

entries.vietlish: this one is broken, I want change other
entries.natural: this one is broken, I want to exchange it for another
entries.sourcePattern: doi cai khac -> change for exchange, other without one
entries.context: This one is broken, I want change other please.

entries.vietlish: this price include tax or not
entries.natural: does this price include tax or not
entries.sourcePattern: gia nay co bao gom thue khong -> no do-support, A-not-A tag
entries.context: This price include tax or not? I want to be sure.

entries.vietlish: please drop me at the corner front
entries.natural: please drop me at the corner ahead
entries.sourcePattern: goc phia truoc -> front placed after noun, front for ahead
entries.context: Please drop me at the corner front, near the bank.

entries.vietlish: which platform the train to Hue
entries.natural: which platform is the train to Hue
entries.sourcePattern: tau di Hue san ga nao -> copula dropped in the question
entries.context: Excuse me, which platform the train to Hue?

entries.vietlish: stop here is ok for me
entries.natural: you can stop here, that's fine for me
entries.sourcePattern: dung o day duoc -> bare imperative as subject clause
entries.context: Driver, stop here is ok for me, thank you.

entries.vietlish: the salary is how much for this position
entries.natural: what is the salary for this position
entries.sourcePattern: luong bao nhieu -> embedded how much instead of what
entries.context: The salary is how much for this position, may I ask?

entries.vietlish: I have experience three years in sales
entries.natural: I have three years of experience in sales
entries.sourcePattern: kinh nghiem ba nam -> noun-number order plus missing of
entries.context: I have experience three years in sales and customer service.

entries.vietlish: I want to take a day leave tomorrow
entries.natural: I want to take a day off tomorrow
entries.sourcePattern: xin nghi mot ngay -> leave for day off, wrong noun
entries.context: I want to take a day leave tomorrow for a family event.

entries.vietlish: he is sleeping, don't make noise loud
entries.natural: he is sleeping, don't make a loud noise
entries.sourcePattern: dung lam on to -> adjective loud placed after noun
entries.context: The baby he is sleeping, don't make noise loud.

entries.vietlish: she has a sweet voice very
entries.natural: she has a very sweet voice
entries.sourcePattern: giong ngot lam -> degree word very placed at the end
entries.context: She has a sweet voice very, she should sing.

entries.vietlish: the soup needs more salt a little
entries.natural: the soup needs a little more salt
entries.sourcePattern: them mot it -> quantifier a little placed after the noun
entries.context: The soup needs more salt a little, it is bland.

entries.vietlish: I am so hungry, I can eat a horse almost
entries.natural: I am so hungry, I could almost eat a horse
entries.sourcePattern: gan nhu -> almost placed at the end of the clause
entries.context: Skip lunch and now I am so hungry, I can eat a horse almost.

entries.vietlish: she wears a perfume very strong
entries.natural: she's wearing very strong perfume
entries.sourcePattern: xit nuoc hoa thom -> article plus adjective after noun
entries.context: She wears a perfume very strong, I can smell it from far.

entries.vietlish: the class has finished, students go out all
entries.natural: the class has finished, all the students are going out
entries.sourcePattern: ra het -> quantifier all placed after the verb
entries.context: When the class has finished, students go out all at once.

entries.vietlish: the river water is very dirty now
entries.natural: the river is very dirty now
entries.sourcePattern: nuoc song -> redundant water noun before adjective
entries.context: After the rain, the river water is very dirty now.

entries.vietlish: he gave back me the money yesterday
entries.natural: he gave me back the money yesterday
entries.sourcePattern: tra lai tien cho toi -> particle placement, back before object
entries.context: He gave back me the money yesterday, so we are even.

entries.vietlish: please turn left at the next light
entries.natural: please turn left at the next traffic light
entries.sourcePattern: den giao thong -> light for traffic light, ambiguous noun
entries.context: To my house, please turn left at the next light.

entries.vietlish: my English is still weak, sorry
entries.natural: my English is still poor, sorry
entries.sourcePattern: tieng Anh con yeu -> weak calqued for poor ability
entries.context: Please speak slowly, my English is still weak, sorry.

entries.vietlish: she is doing the master in London
entries.natural: she is doing a master's in London
entries.sourcePattern: hoc thac si -> the for a plus master without 's
entries.context: She is doing the master in London for two years.
